title: Hooks
description: Use React hooks to manage stateful component behavior.

lessons.title: Why Hooks Exist
lessons.description: Understand what hooks solve and how hook rules keep components predictable.

lessons.title: useEffect Mental Model
lessons.description: Understand effects as synchronization after render, not as event handlers.

lessons.title: Effect Dependencies
lessons.description: Reason about dependency arrays and keep effects synchronized with current values.

lessons.title: Effect Cleanup
lessons.description: Clean up timers, subscriptions, and external work created by effects.

lessons.title: useRef
lessons.description: Use refs for stable mutable values that should not trigger rendering.

lessons.title: Custom Hooks
lessons.description: Extract reusable stateful behavior into focused custom hooks.
